statement: Paper B Lemma 5.1: the contracting words of length at most five with no proper nonempty contracting prefix are exactly E, OE, OOEE, OOOEE, and OOEOE. Their formal cylinder measures sum to 1/2+1/4+1/16+1/32+1/32=7/8 (and the four-step and 27/32 subfamily sums likewise). Lean: Problems.Juggler.PaperBCertificates.lemma51 and certificate_measures_sum. This is the combinatorial classification only; it does not count starts, bound exponential sums, or prove Theorem 5.4. The two subfamily sums are separate declarations: four_step_measures_sum is 1/2+1/4+1/16 = 13/16 and twenty_seven_thirty_two_sum is 13/16+1/32 = 27/32.
